defaults.motion_elements: the candle flames and the snow outside the windows

shots.subject: A small stone chapel aisle lined on both sides with pillar candles in glass lanterns, wooden pews with pine sprigs and red ribbons on each end, leading to an altar with an advent wreath and arched windows with snow outside

A plain stone altar with a white cloth, a large fir advent wreath with four lit candles, tall brass candlesticks and a pine garland, a stained-glass window of abstract gold and ruby patterns glowing behind
A small country stone church in the snow at dusk, warm light glowing through its arched windows, a wreath on the wooden door and a lantern-lined path through the snowy churchyard with pines behind
shots.motion_elements: the glowing windows, the path lanterns and the falling snow
shots.ambient: Snow falls. Lantern flames flicker along the path.

shots.subject: A tall arched stained-glass window of abstract geometric patterns in gold, ruby and blue glowing at night above a stone sill crowded with lit candles and a pine garland
shots.motion_elements: the candle flames and the glow of the stained glass

shots.subject: Low side view along one row of dark oak chapel pews, the camera at the end of a pew looking across the row: small wreaths of box leaves and red berries on each pew end and a lit candle in a glass jar on the stone floor beside each, the candlelight receding diagonally; plain clear leaded windows with snow outside
A view from the wooden choir loft of a stone chapel, over a balustrade draped in garland, across rows of empty pews to a candlelit altar with a tall lit tree beside it
A whitewashed Scandinavian wooden chapel with simple pews, rows of white candles in black iron candelabras, a straw star hanging in each small square window and snow falling outside
A tiered brass candle stand of small votive candles glowing against a stone wall, a sprig of pine and red berries at its base
shots.ambient: The small candle flames flicker softly.

shots.subject: A Romanesque stone chapel with a barrel-vaulted ceiling, a hanging iron wheel chandelier of lit candles above the aisle, garlands spiralled on the columns and small arched windows with snow outside
shots.motion_elements: the candle flames on the chandelier and the altar, and the snow outside the windows
shots.ambient: Candle flames flicker on the hanging chandelier and the altar.

shots.subject: A chapel side altar niche with a bank of lit candles, a wreath hung on the stone wall, white winter roses and pine in a stone urn and an arched window with snow falling outside
A tall Gothic chapel nave with pointed stone arches, candle lanterns on every column, a long red runner down the aisle between garland-trimmed pews and tall lancet windows at the far end
shots.focus: the far end of the nave

shots.subject: A carved wooden pipe organ in a chapel loft, its console lit by two brass candle lamps, a garland with warm lights along the pipes and candlelit pews below
shots.motion_elements: the candle flames and the garland lights

shots.subject: A white wooden country chapel with a slim steeple in a snowy meadow at golden hour, a wreath on its red door, candles glowing in the windows, snowy pines and a split-rail fence, light snow flurries sparkling in the sun
shots.motion_elements: the glowing windows and the falling snow flurries
shots.ambient: Light snow flurries drift down. Candlelight glows in the windows.

shots.subject: An advent wreath of fir, holly and pinecones with four ivory candles lit, resting on dark wood, candlelight catching the holly berries and the altar glow blurred behind
The arched oak chapel door seen from inside, standing open onto a snowy churchyard with lanterns, a large wreath on the door and candle lanterns on the stone floor on either side
shots.focus: the open door and the snow outside
shots.motion_elements: the lantern flames and the snow falling outside the door
shots.ambient: Snow falls outside the open door. Lantern candles flicker.

shots.subject: A circular stone chapel with a domed roof, pews arranged in a ring around a central table with a large advent wreath of lit candles, candle sconces on the walls and small round windows with snow outside
A carved stone baptismal font ringed with a pine wreath and small candles, lit candle sconces on the pillars nearby and a geometric stained-glass window glowing behind
A hanging iron lantern with a lit candle inside, pine wrapped around its chain, a stone arch and the candlelit chapel softly blurred behind
shots.motion_elements: the candle flame in the lantern and the candle bokeh
shots.ambient: The candle flame flickers inside the lantern.

shots.subject: A small mountain chapel of dark timber with a beamed ceiling, iron lanterns hanging from the beams, a simple altar with a small pine lit with candle-style lights and large windows onto snowy peaks at night
shots.focus: the lit tree by the altar
shots.motion_elements: the lantern flames, the tree lights and the snow outside the windows
shots.ambient: Lantern flames flicker. Snow falls outside the windows.

shots.subject: A dark oak pew end with a small wreath tied with a red velvet ribbon and a lit candle in a glass lantern on the floor, the candlelit aisle blurred behind
